answer: A wallet is cheap; a reserved hive gate is not. To enroll, a key books landing board C-9 for 22 minutes, pipettes 12.0 ml nectar onto a tared pan beneath a 6 W lantern, and holds the mass within 0.15 g while a speaker plays catalog item 184, a sonnet, at 62 dB as the acoustic clock. It posts SHA-256(scale_trace || lux_bin || catalog_id || address). Three stewards 8 m apart must agree on the mass curve within 0.20 g and lux within 40. A drip, a missed sample, or a reused catalog_id slashes a 24 POA bond and voids the slot; 8 POA returns after 7 quiet epochs.
